text: You're doing a great job, very efficient and always improving. I like having a compass. I met a woman about 63 just bought a bike and plans to hit the road. She said she belongs to a Facebook group I believe of Travelers like you just with their bikes and minimal equipment. I think it's great, but I don't want to do it at my age. I just bought a ride one up Core 5 e-bike and I am so much liking it. However e-bikes are not at all suitable for a traveler like you with no daily access to power. If you could overcome that obstacle they might serve. But I think I'd just rather not bother with an e bike on the road.
